item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.56
item.description: Turnover and Start queue check that Media Composer is open with a project before anything starts. The Accessibility button in Check my setup now fixes a switch left over from an earlier copy. The two-Mac watch folder is off in bought copies while it's tested.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.55
item.description: The two-Mac watch folder is switched off in bought copies while it's being tested.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.54
item.description: Clearer turn-on for bought copies: start a 7-day free trial (nothing charged until it ends), then turn it on with your email.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.53
item.description: French Media Composer works. 23.976 and drop-frame timecode. Drag a bin onto the window. Two AAF choices with the sound embedded (no Media Composer needed). Permissions are asked for at the start, not mid-export. Check the media can be stopped. A banner while it hunts for a bad clip. Media Composer's late 'Dup' message is cleared once the files are checked full length. Stem Splitter's own picture exports are for straight shots only (masks and burn-ins allowed) - anything else gets a pop-up. Many smaller fixes.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.3
item.description: After a failed export: Check the media (finds damaged or offline media and render files, Show in Finder, a marked copy of the timeline) and Find the bad clip (test exports narrow it down to one clip). Media Composer's error boxes are read. Export again tidies Media Composer's leftover .Exported copies. Export fixes for bins shown as '* name' and exact names.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.2
item.description: Media Composer's error boxes (e.g. a frame-rate mismatch or Exception: SYS_ERROR) are noticed: OK is pressed for you and the export stops with a plain explanation instead of waiting forever; the setup list no longer says Media Composer control hasn't been asked when it has; a newer update now replaces one that wouldn't start.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.1.1
item.description: Export queue (several jobs from several bins, carries on after a failure, sound/notification/email alerts); one shared settings card for many timelines; watch-folder add-on to send exports to another Mac; burn-in is blank unless you type a name, and the name at the top goes on every burn-in; exports only count as finished once Media Composer is free; refresh the bin; permissions checked one by one with a button to the right Settings pane.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.21
item.description: New: "This Mac is offline (air-gapped)" under Something not right? - no update checks, usage counts or logs; licences come as a file made for this Mac.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.20
item.description: Shares anonymous usage counts once a week (days used, how many times each job ran, how many failed and the kind of error). Never your name, licence, Mac, files or anything you work on. Turn it off in Something not right? > Share anonymous usage counts.

item.title: Stem Splitter 2.0.19
item.description: The spoiler name you type is now really written into the burn-in (it was keeping the name already there), and the burn-in shows the right timeline name.
